name: teams-guest-bot-desktop
description: Teams Guest Bot — Windows desktop app (Electron). Records Teams meetings via guest browser join.
author: e&

scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:web
scripts.playwright:install: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$env:PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH='0'; npx playwright install chromium"
scripts.electron:dev: npm run build:all && npm run build:electron && electron .
scripts.electron:build: npm run build:all && npm run build:windows-helper && npm run playwright:install && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
